module_summary: Sequence detector using child state machine (sd_route) advancing through states on input bits, detecting completion when reaching MATCH state (111).

anchors.name: ph_r
anchors.why: Phase/state register tracking position in sequence; updated by child sd_route logic

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: Serial input bit driving state machine transitions via sd_route child

anchors.name: sequence_detected
anchors.why: Output detection pulse when sequence complete (ph_r == Q_MATCH)

anchors.name: ph_d
anchors.why: Next state output from sd_route child; feeds back into ph_r on clock

anchors.name: eq_w
anchors.why: Sequence match detection (XNOR reduction of ph_r vs Q_MATCH); drives output

groups.name: State_Machine
groups.description: FSM state register with child state routing module

groups.name: Match_Detection
groups.description: Sequence match comparator detecting target state
